title: ZPA Private Service Edge Release Summary (2024)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge version.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released to support the version check and automated upgrade of ZPA Private Service Edge versions 24.650.5 and above during an initial connection. To learn more, see Zscaler Trust.
An update was released to provide support for using the same Application (FQDN) for multiple application segments.
An update was released to improve cloud support and scalability.
An update was released to support Active Directory controls for AppProtection. To learn more, see Active Directory Controls.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see Understanding ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
A recommended update was released that includes updated ZPA Private Service Edge RPM packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.x, 8x, and 9.x. The Manager software version is 24.650.5.
To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: Support for Business Continuity. To learn more, see Business Continuity Support.

Enhancement to ZPA Private Service Edges to promote only Client-to-Client connections and not Client-to-Server traffic when overlapping Client Hostname Validation and application segments are configured. To learn more, see Understanding Client-to-Client Connectivity.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see Understanding ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
A recommended update was released that includes updated Private Service Edge RPM packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.x, 8x, and 9.x. To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.
This Private Service Edge version includes a fix to address an issue that might have prevented some users from connecting to a ZPA Private Service Edge.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software and Understanding ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.

blocks.item: An update was released that provides support for server-side certificate posture validation.

An update was released that ensures client-to-client connectivity is successful when source and destination users are connected to different ZPA Private Service Edges or ZPA Public Service Edges and there is no dedicated application segment configured for client-to-client functionality.
